newsitem.title: USA: Romanian nabbed with guns at Florida airport jailed.
newsitem.headline: Romanian nabbed with guns at Florida airport jailed.

text.p: A Romanian seminary student who tried to board a plane carrying a bag stuffed with guns and grenades has been sentenced to four years and seventh months in prison, the Attorney General's Office said Friday.
Roman Christian Regman, 21, had earlier pleaded guilty to four counts of federal firearms offences.
Regman, a Romanian citizen with U.S. permanent resident status, was a seminary student at St.Tikhon, part of the Orthodox Church, at Scranton, Pennsylvania.

He was arrested at Tampa airport on Sept. 2 boarding a Pennsylvania-bound plane with an arsenal in his bag. The cache included a Beretta pistol, a rifle, grenades, military knives, several hundred rounds of ammunition, a ski mask and gloves.
A later search of his apartment in Brooksville, Florida, about 60 miles (100 km) north of Tampa, yielded an AK-47 assualt rifle, a silencer and other explosives.

Regman maintained he had an "innocent" use for the weapons and had merely been thoughtless in trying to carry them onto the plane. Judge Steven Merryday disagreed and sentenced him on Thursday to four years and seven months in jail followed by three years of supervised release.
